body.statement: Fix \(N=4\). On any cell \(J\) on which the channel support, confidence-primal basis, confidence-dual basis, and signs of the dual positive parts are fixed, membership \((\lambda,\alpha)\in\mathcal B_{4,\alpha}\) is equivalent to the existence of a certificate \(\Gamma_J\) that simultaneously verifies primal feasibility, dual feasibility, complementary slackness, channel stationarity including active privacy faces, and nonnegativity of every residual polynomial over the whole staircase polytope. Every boundary point internal to the projection of \(J\) is a real root of a determinant, inactive-slack, residual-contact, or candidate-value-difference polynomial generated by \(\Gamma_J\).
body.justification: This is the exact optimality certificate and finite boundary-candidate theorem needed to turn a phase diagram into mathematics.
body.gap: Mai supplies generic finite-convergence conditions, while the present equivalence must fuse a confidence LP saddle, privacy-face stationarity, and global residual positivity without assuming a rational optimizer.
body.consumer: It gives an independently checkable certificate format for choosing a private trial design and for auditing the privacy budget at which the optimal channel family changes.
